label: Agent Commit Feed
description: Who wrote this week's commits — a commit feed colour-coded by author (human vs coding agent), with the agent-authored share, a proportion bar and a legend. The alpine commit feed nested under its own card; composes at any canvas.

subtitle.label: Subtitle
subtitle.description: Line under the title — the repo and window.

commits.label: Commits
commits.description: Commits, newest last. `agent` names the coding agent that wrote it ("Claude Code", "Copilot", "Cursor"); leave it empty for a human-authored commit. `author` is the human on the commit. Up to 7 are drawn.

agentColor.label: Agent colour
agentColor.description: Colour for agent-authored commits (chip, bar, legend).

humanColor.label: Human colour
humanColor.description: Colour for human-authored commits (chip, bar, legend).

anim.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
anim.reduceMotion.description: Skip motion; render the final static card.

anim.introFrac.label: Intro length
anim.introFrac.description: Share of the clip the intro fills (the rest holds).

anim.renderMode.label: Render mode
anim.renderMode.description: premium = alpha-fade cascade; light = enable-gate pops (cheaper when nested).

anim.label: Animation
anim.description: Reveal: the feed's rows cascade in; the share band fades. reduceMotion renders the final frame.
